Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly swapped the death dates of the two individuals in its "Updated Understanding" section. It stated that Narcís Ventalló died on 16 July 1992 (which is actually H. Verlan Andersen's death date) and that H. Verlan Andersen died on 22 December 2018 (which is actually Narcís Ventalló's death date). This data swap led to the logically consistent but factually wrong final conclusion that H. Verlan Andersen died later, when the correct conclusion should be that Narcís Ventalló died later (2018 vs 1992).
